title: Rory and the Moonlit Pebble Path
verses:
The moon rose up above the hill,
And cast a silver glow,
Where Rory walked a pebble path,
With footsteps soft and slow.

Beside a giant shady tree,
Benny rested on the ground,
Where Nia swooped from up above,
Without a single sound.

Now Ricky found a fluffy fern,
To make a cozy bed,
While Psittaco tucked safely in,
To rest a sleepy head.

Then Tilly yawned and settled down,
Beside the quiet stream,
And closed her eyes so happily,
To start a gentle dream.

The stars shone bright across the dark,
The breeze was soft and light,
Where Rory curled beside his friends,
To bid them all goodnight.

Now every friend was fast asleep,
Beneath the silver sky,
While nighttime sang a lullaby,
As gentle clouds rolled by.
